record.one_liner: Klaviyo provides a robust REST API with comprehensive resource coverage, supporting API keys and OAuth for authentication.

auth_methods.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).

access_test.quote: Check out our Get started with Klaviyo series to set up an account, obtain API credentials, and authenticate.
